items.description: Report does not give a numeric or structural definition of reachability beyond the headOrder/tailOrder chain membership; the chain-membership relation is represented as a grounded Boolean pending code binding.
No concrete prior transaction or initial allocation establishing the non-head order is given; p_nonhead_order_exists is a structural condition, not an observed history.
Report gives no numeric definition of open-interest counters or reachable-order count, so the correspondence is represented as a grounded Boolean rather than an arithmetic equality.
